message: Thanks, I'll help you check what you might qualify for. I have a few questions. To start: which state do you live in, and how many children under 18 live in your household? summary: Household of 5 in Nebraska: married couple, 3 children, owns home, one adult self-employed (delivery driver) with roughly $156k to $180k a year in work income, employer health insurance available, no seniors, disabilities, pregnancies, under-5s, or college students. Income is far above the limits for SNAP, WIC, TANF, SSI, Medicaid, CHIP, EITC, school meals, and ACA premium credit (employer coverage offered). The refundable Child Tax Credit (ACTC) is likely available since earned income is well above the $2,500 threshold; the full credit is still available at this income level for a married couple. Savings amount was never given exactly but does not change these results. Confirm ages of the children (must be under 17 at year end) and the tax-filing details when claiming.
